```{r,echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
cost_energy_plot <- function(file_path, weighted_points = TRUE,targetCol="cost") {
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)

  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  if (!("probability" %in% names(df)) && ("prob" %in% names(df))) {
    df <- df %>% rename(probability = prob)
  }
  if (!("probability" %in% names(df))) {
    df <- df %>% mutate(probability = 1)
  }

  if (!all(c("energy", targetCol) %in% names(df))) {
    stop("not energy or cost")
  }

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      energy = as.numeric(energy),
      cost = as.numeric(.data[[targetCol]]),
      probability = as.numeric(probability),
      cost = factor(cost, levels = sort(unique(cost))) 
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(energy), is.finite(probability), probability >= 0)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cost, y = energy)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(size = if (weighted_points) probability else NULL),
      width = 0.18, alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Cost", y = "Energy", title = "Energy distribution by Cost")

  if (weighted_points) {
    p <- p + scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 6))
  }

  print(p)
}




```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
cost_energy_boxplot_prob <- function(file_path, show_points = TRUE,targetCol="cost",thresh="()",opt="") {
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)

  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  if (!("probability" %in% names(df)) && ("prob" %in% names(df))) {
    df <- df %>% rename(probability = prob)
  }

  df <- df %>%
    transmute(
      cost = as.numeric(.data[[targetCol]]),
      energy = as.numeric(energy),
      probability = as.numeric(probability)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(energy), is.finite(probability), probability > 0)

  w0 <- min(df$probability)
  df_exp <- df %>%
    mutate(w = pmax(1L, round(probability / w0))) %>%
    uncount(w)

  p <- ggplot(df_exp, aes(x = factor(cost), y = energy)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = targetCol, y = "Energy",
         title = glue("Energy vs {targetCol}; thres: {thresh};opt:{opt} "))

  if (show_points) {
    br <- sort(unique(df$probability))
    p <- p +
      geom_point(
        data = df,
        aes(size = probability),
        alpha = 0.5,
        position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0)
      ) +
      scale_size_continuous(breaks = br, labels = br, name = "probability")
  }

  print(p)
}

```
